title: Executive Turntable: Caroline Wright Named EVP, North American Venues At Legends Global
summary: Other highlights this week include GoDigital launching Nashville-based country imprint Orinda
contentText:
Caroline Wright has joined Legends Global as executive vp of North American venues. She previously served as senior vp and chief venues officer at Tepper Sports & Entertainment, and had spent 27 years at Maple Leaf Sports & Entertainment, where she rose to vp of operations and general manager of venues.

“Caroline brings a rare combination of operational experience and strategic vision that will continue to straighten our network of North American venues,” Josh Kritzler , president of North American Venues & Content at Legends Global said in a statement. “Her ability to manage complexity at scale while keeping partners and fans at the center is unmatched. We’re excited to welcome her to our team and energized by what we will build together.”

While at Tepper Sports & Entertainment, Wright led venue operations and capital strategy for Bank of America Stadium and Atrium Health Performance Park. She negotiated a $650 million public investment for Bank of America Stadium’s $800 million renovation for the NFL’s Carolina Panthers.

At Maple Leaf Sports & Entertainment, she directed seven facilities for the Toronto Maple Leafs, Toronto Raptors, Toronto FC and Toronto Argonauts.

Legends venue network holds more than 250 venues including Caesars Superdome in New Orleans, Soldier Field in Chicago, US Bank Stadium in Minneapolis, T-Mobile Center in Kansas City, Coliseo de Puerto Rico in Puerto Rico and The Greek Theatre in Los Angeles.

“Legends Global has built a trusted reputation by combining deep expertise with a genuine commitment to its partners and the experiences they deliver on the world’s biggest stages,” Wright said in a statement. “I’m proud to join this team and bring the operational discipline and partnership-first approach that has defined my career to help our venues perform at their very best.”
